fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-01-08, the complainant reported threatening messages from a loan recovery number regarding Rs. 8,000. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-01-03 around 19:25 hrs. Sanjay Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000083. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Recovery agents allegedly sent abusive messages to the borrower and contacts.
fields.Keywords: loan app, harassment, digital document, residential colony, evening
